localizedDescriptions.en: Check vehicle status, battery charge, and recent charging activity from Tessie.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 通过 Tessie 查看车辆状态、电池电量及近期充电记录。

en: Summarize the current battery level and charging status for my vehicle.
zh-CN: 总结我的车辆当前的电池电量和充电状态。

instructions.en: Generate an access token in Tessie Developer Settings and enter it in the plugin settings.
instructions.zh-CN: 在 Tessie 的开发者设置中生成访问令牌，再填入插件设置。
